scope: Only the logical/JSON/AI and design/container reference replacements

upstream.author: Darrin Southern
upstream.policy: Retain factual coverage and CadenceUX-authored synthesis under attribution. Replace expressive literal worked examples individually, including secondary examples, output fixtures and concrete inline scenarios. Do not treat the surrounding CC-licensed synthesis as prohibited Claris expression. This manifest contains replacement descriptions, not original example blocks.

per_reference: Ordered function signatures match upstream exactly
Function/pattern section counts match upstream and manifest
No unchanged expressive fenced example blocks (actual intersection was empty for both files)
Author, organization, license and commit attribution present
All manifest source line ranges are within source bounds
Manifest ranges cover every upstream line
All fenced JSON output fixtures parse with Python json
independent_fixture_checks: Cedar Base64 expectation using Python base64
Star map Base64 decoding expectation using Python base64
Skymap hexadecimal decoding expectation using Python bytes.fromhex
Three-dimensional normalization unit length using Python math
Sum/difference normalization component magnitudes using Python math

checks_run.manifest_check: Engine test and external-call counts are zero
checks_run.limitations: These are structural/content and independent fixture checks, not FileMaker syntax, script configuration, model inference, cryptographic engine, OCR, SQL engine or provider integration tests.

validation.outputs: Expected illustrations or explicitly synthetic fixtures; not recorded FileMaker output. Pure arithmetic and encoding expectations may be checked independently, which does not validate FileMaker execution.
validation.script_outlines: Bracketed script steps describe configuration, not pasteable calculation syntax. Angle-bracket placeholders require deliberate environment setup.
security: AI accounts, providers, models, endpoints, layouts and secrets are explicit environment inputs; provider-backed outlines would transmit data if configured and run, but were not executed.
Evaluate syntax/error checks are not authorization or sandboxing. Custom functions and plug-ins can have side effects; even an error-check evaluation executes the expression.
UI closure/navigation, exports, field writes and QR URL opening are unexecuted operations requiring review.
Keys/passwords are secret-store inputs, not embedded production secrets.

coverage.counting_note: Function/pattern headings exclude Contents and category introductions. Fenced-block counts include output fixtures and are not scenario counts: related demonstrations may share a fence, and prose can carry a replacement output. Source headings inside fenced script comments are not category boundaries. All 94 real functions, one nonexistent-function warning and five common-pattern sections are retained.
